reasons: Quantity matches: the OTel postgresql.operations metric with operation="hot_upd" measures the same heap-only (hot) row updates as postgresql.rows_hot_updated, with unit '1' on both sides.
Grouping is dropped: the Datadog query is avg by {db}, but the candidate computes a single avg over all series with no by clause, so per-database series are collapsed.

Template variables are not applied: $db maps to a postgresql_database_name=~"$db" matcher and $host to host_name=~"$host" (both observed labels), and neither is present, so the candidate covers a different set of series.
$scope (no prefix, default *) is correctly dropped, and $table is unused by the query, so neither causes a mismatch.
Outcome translated is appropriate because no function blocks the request and an OTel equivalent exists.
